messages:
Sara: heads up — i'm proposing a change to how we sample request/response telemetry for low-latency routes. current global sampler is causing noisy spikes during bursts and makes quota math hard. idea: per-route adaptive smoothing + a short-lived `inspect` toggle in the console. looking for ops + legal + devex input.

Mike: curious — how do you define 'adaptive smoothing'? rough perf impact?

Sara: good q. minimal change to runtime: keep current sampler but add a per-route controller that adjusts sample rate with an EWMA over recent qps and token cost. smoothing window ~60s, floor=0.1%, cap=20% for chatty routes. runtime only changes sampling decision, no extra payloads.

Mike: ewma makes sense. can you share the formula? also: will this affect our cost forecasting pipelines?

Sara: formula is basically: new_rate = alpha * observed_rate + (1 - alpha) * previous_rate, where observed_rate = min( max_budget / est_token_cost, 1 ). alpha=0.3 default. forecasting unchanged because we emit the effective sample_rate metric per-route and per-model.

Alex: from a console perspective — we need to make `inspect` safe and obvious. proposal: per-route inspect button that creates a short-lived token (TTL 10m) and an audit entry. UI shows current sample rate and a slider for manual override (dev only). default: off.

Tara: product question — for new customers, do we default to adaptive on or off? onboarding confusion is a risk. recommend: adaptive ON for system routes (health checks, routing) but OFF for customer request bodies until legal signoff.

Jessica: legal here — +1 to audit entries. also require ephemeral retention for raw payloads captured during inspect. suggested limits: max 30 days for any full request/response, pseudonymize user identifiers using HMAC before storage, and require org-admin opt-in for inspect on private deployments.

Sara: noted. here's a sample route config we can ship as a flag:

```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "sampling": {
    "mode": "adaptive",
    "alpha": 0.3,
    "floor_pct": 0.001,
    "cap_pct": 0.2,
    "budget_tokens_per_min": 250000
  },
  "inspect": {
    "enabled": true,
    "ttl_seconds": 600,
    "audit_log": "true"
  }
}
```

Sara: runtime will expose metrics: `route.sample_rate`, `route.sampled_tokens`, `route.inspect_grants`. these feed the billing/forecasting pipeline.

Mike: operational note — we should add a graceful degrade: if sampler controller crashes, fallback to previous static config (non-adaptive) and emit an incident metric. also add an RPM hard-cap so we don't flood storage if cap_pct mis-set.

Alex: for UI telemetry we need to surface: last 24h effective sample rate, number of inspect grants, and last grant owner. also record which admin toggled manual override.

Tara: rollout plan idea: 1) feature-flag runtime for internal routes only, 2) enable console read-only metrics for a week, 3) allow dev teams to opt-in to inspect via flag, 4) widen to customers after legal signoff and a canary.

Jessica: i can sign off once we have HMAC hooks and retention policy documented. add the pseudonymization library to the PR.

Sara: i'll open an RFC + PR with the config changes and a small e2e test. will add the HMAC plugin link. thanks.

deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled for 2025-09-01 03:00 UTC — rolling to 10% routes with feature flag `adaptive-sampler`.

Mike: thanks — will watch `route.sample_rate` dashboards and alert if 5xx or token spend > expected. :thumbsup:

Alex: i'll mock up the console tile and post screenshots later today.

Tara: adding to rollout checklist.

Sara: perfect — follow-ups in the RFC thread.
